title: Updating a term through the API matches spelling, or saves unknown text
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Have a valid Public API key for the test organization, the Public API documentation from the developers (it gives the request to create, update and read a customer), and a request tool.
  • Make sure the shop's own term A is named "Net 10".
  • Make sure customer A exists on Net 30.
  • If you cannot set up any of the above, mark this test Blocked: "setup not done".
custom_steps:
1. Send a Public API request that updates customer A's credit term to "NET10".
  2. Open customer A's customer page.
  3. Send a Public API request that updates customer A's credit term to "Prepaid".
  4. Reload customer A's customer page.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • The request is accepted (no error comes back).

Step 2:

  • The "Credit term" reads "Net 10".

Step 3:

  • The request is accepted (it is not refused).

Step 4:

  • The "Credit term" reads "Prepaid" exactly as sent.

The tester sends a Public API request in this case. The exact request is added once the API documentation or tech plan is shared; until then the case is held.
